slot_scores.name: missing_objective
slot_scores.evidence_quote: What is the goal of this plan — are you minimizing total cost, or is there another objective (such as maximizing tables, or meeting a target cost)?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked about the optimization objective and whether it is minimizing total cost.

slot_scores.name: A_requires_min_B_tables
slot_scores.evidence_quote: For the first requirement — "if we order from Supplier A, we must also order at least 30 tables from Supplier B" — does this mean the number of tables from Supplier B must be at least 30 (i.e., at least 2 orders of 15 tables each), or does it mean at least 30 tables in total from all suppliers combined?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly clarified the conditional A-to-B minimum table requirement, including its interpretation.

slot_scores.name: B_requires_C_order
slot_scores.evidence_quote: For the second requirement — "if we place an order with Supplier B, we must also place an order with Supplier C" — does this mean that whenever we order at least one order from Supplier B, we must order at least one order from Supplier C (i.e., at least 15 tables from C), or is there a different minimum number of tables from Supplier C required?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked about the conditional B-to-C ordering requirement and its minimum interpretation.
